name: Introduction and overview — Akula-class Submarine — ship record
title: Introduction and overview — Akula-class Submarine
description: Introduction and overview of the Akula-class Submarine: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. The Soviet Akula class — 15 built — was Moscow's quietest attack submarine, a rude shock to Western navies when its low noise levels were revealed. With four 533mm and four 650mm torpedo tubes, Akulas remain Russia's premier attack boats; one was leased to India as INS Chakra. Baseline facts: Soviet/Russian attack submarine; 15 built; famously quiet; leased to India..
